verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a state business-filing portal, since government e-filing systems can offer test environments for software filers, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a sandbox, test mode, or non-production environment for Ohio SOS or the Business Gateway. The items cover portal profiles, OHID sign-in, tax tools, and robots.txt walls, none of which bear on sandboxing.
